# Punarjanam by Yogini Maansi

> Drop-in yoga sessions and small curated retreats in Rishikesh, India, for travellers and beginners. No teacher training or certification.

- [contact.html](https://h4r5h-d.github.io/punarjanam/contact.html)

- [Five days, a different rhythm](https://h4r5h-d.github.io/punarjanam/retreats/five-days-a-different-rhythm.html): 5 days, 4 nights, Shared on enquiry
- [Women's circle](https://h4r5h-d.github.io/punarjanam/retreats/womens-circle.html): 3 days, 2 nights, Shared on enquiry
